name: Decoupled Toolbox for Duration Field
description: Makes Duration Field compatible with Decoupled Toolbox.
project_description: Decoupled Toolbox for Duration Field is a sub-module of Decoupled Toolbox. Makes Duration Field compatible with Decoupled Toolbox. It ships a single decoupled field formatter (plugin `decoupled_duration_field`, class `DurationFieldDecoupledFormatter`) so that duration fields can be placed on the Decoupled view mode and serialized to JSON by the parent module's collection endpoint. Requires the contrib Duration Field module. Extends `GenericDecoupledFormatter`.
